description: Starts the REP27 7-day free trial (no card) for the given contact name, work email, company and country. The user receives an email to continue.

country.description: Country where the company is established
country.title: Country

email.description: Work email of the contact person, as given by the user
email.title: Email

lang.description: Language code for the answer (ISO 639-1, e.g. en, it, es, fr, de, pt, nl, pl, ja, zh)
lang.title: Lang

name.description: Full name of the contact person, as given by the user
name.title: Name

notes.description: Optional short note from the user
notes.title: Notes

service.description: Service to try: GDPR representative EU, UK or both, or GPSR responsible person
service.title: Service

name: start_free_trial
title: Start the 7-day free trial
